title: CB Libs
headline: CB Libs v3.0.1
description: Framework compatibility, startup reporting and centralized update-check release.
changes: Added shared versioned startup banners for every Codebyte resource.
Added one cached public version-catalog request, update alerts and the cbversions console command.
Improved provider messages to identify RSG compatibility supplied by MULTIcore and MULTIinventory.
Added release workflows and a public version catalog for automatic version publishing.
Removed obsolete Python test files while retaining the required native-storage installer.
